description: Send back the message from get_wallet_challenge, unchanged, with its signature. On success that address becomes the one this account pays from, and every order is frozen against it: a payment from any other wallet is not that order's payment and is not delivered. Needs your API key in the Authorization header: "Bearer hsq_agent_...".

signature.description: That message, signed by the address (EIP-191).
